sentences.en: Aconitum Napellus, common monkshood, is a doubtful native of Britain, and is of therapeutic and toxicological importance.

sentences.en: The majority of samples contained aflatoxins at low levels which were not of toxicological concern.

sentences.en: All additives under a toxicological cloud to be withdrawn immediately pending a complete review of their safety.

sentences.en: Toxicological studies indicated that ochratoxin A is a teratogenic, mutagenic and carcinogenic mycotoxin with the strong toxic effects on liver and kidney.
sentences.vi: Các nghiên cứu về độc tính chỉ ra rằng ochratoxin A là một loại độc tố nấm mốc gây quái thai, gây đột biến và gây ung thư với tác dụng độc mạnh đối với gan và thận.

sentences.en: Toxicological safety of tartary buckwheat extracts (TBE) wasobserved by way of feeding TBE to mouse and rat.

sentences.en: Pharmacokinetics, toxicological functions, drug residue, withdrawal time and the application perspective are summarized in this article.

sentences.en: Since silane is spontaneously flammable in air, its toxicological properties are difficult to determine.
sentences.vi: Vì silan dễ cháy tự phát trong không khí nên rất khó xác định các đặc tính độc học của nó.
